strings.jp: 準備をしていた{n}タヌキやウサギが{n}最後のマキを運びにいった！
strings.en: The tanuki and rabbits who had been getting ready went off to carry the last of the firewood!

strings.jp: たーまやー！{n}かーぎやー！{n}{wait}{n}カチカチ山の 花火は{n}ウサギとタヌキの{n}友情のあかし！{wait}{n}その花火の 光は{n}みんなの 心も{n}明るく 照らすのでした！
strings.en: Ooooh! Aaaah!{wait}The fireworks of Kachikachi Mountain are proof of the friendship between the rabbits and the tanuki!{wait}And their light brightened everyone's hearts, too!
